rows.Origin:
Bred by Harkness & Co. (United Kingdom, 1995).
Introduced in United Kingdom by R Harkness & Co. Ltd. in 1995 as 'Reconciliation'.
rows.Bloom: Peach, buff undertones. Strong fragrance. 40 petals. Average diameter 6". Very large, very full (41+ petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium. Dark green, leathery foliage.

Height: 35" to 4' (90 to 120cm). Width: 2' to 3' (60 to 90cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b through 10b. Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
